metadata.title: PlasmaBENCH: TimSim synthetic ground-truth data for benchmarking DIA software on TimsTOF mixed-proteome plasma (PYE1)
metadata.description:
Data archive for PlasmaBENCH, a benchmark of DIA software (DIA-NN, FragPipe) on TimsTOF mixed-proteome plasma data using TimSim-generated synthetic ground truth. The PYE1 design (Plasma · Yeast · E. coli) is a three-species ratio test: human plasma background 1:1 between Sample A and B, while yeast (expected B/A = 3.0) and E. coli (expected B/A = 0.5) move in opposite directions. TimSim emits an exact per-precursor blueprint alongside every simulated .d, so species-resolved recall, FDR, and ratio recovery can be scored against known truth.

Contents (three tarballs that unpack into the PlasmaBENCH repo root):

  • plasmabench-data-raw.tar.zst → data/raw/: search FASTA, the blank .d (noise source), the real G PYE1 .ds, FragPipe DDA inputs.
  • plasmabench-simulations.tar.zst → simulations/: simulated Sample A/B .ds, the synthetic_data.db TimSim blueprint (ground truth), seeds, rendered configs.
  • plasmabench-results.tar.zst → results/: our DIA-NN 1.8 / 2.5 / 2.6 reports. Predicted spectral libraries (*.predicted.speclib, ~20 GB) are deliberately excluded.

Bring your own search engines. DIA-NN and FragPipe binaries are NOT included (they have their own licenses); install your own to reproduce. Step-by-step reproduction instructions are in REPRODUCE.md in the code repository.

Code: https://github.com/theGreatHerrLebert/PlasmaBENCH — Simulator: TimSim (rustims). PlasmaBENCH reproduces in silico the mixed-proteome plasma benchmark of Distler et al., Nat Commun 2025 (DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-64501-z; data PXD056598).
metadata.notes: Predicted spectral libraries (*.predicted.speclib) and search-engine binaries are intentionally excluded. Reproduce by installing your own DIA-NN / FragPipe and following REPRODUCE.md. FILL_ME items in creators must be completed before publishing.
